scope: read-only sealed evidence; no Isaac execution or original seal promotion
decision_order: verify frozen assignment and all pre-Path gates
replay all post-Path gates with the assignment-only validator
verify host and container SHA plus resource and cleanup evidence
only then inspect Outcome and build a separate analysis dataset
accepted_validator_change: Replace a fixed count of three unique Path SHA values per period with exact four-slot role and SHA equality against the frozen assignment; use the same function before and after Path publication.

classification.audit_pass: Every required gate is independently verified from sealed evidence after removing only the erroneous fixed Path-kind count.
classification.audit_inconclusive: At least one required gate cannot be verified from available evidence, and no actual mismatch is established.
classification.audit_fail: A required gate has a verified protocol mismatch.

missing_evidence_policy: Never infer or fill missing measurements; classify audit_inconclusive unless a verified mismatch establishes audit_fail.
provenance_policy: Keep original failed seal invalid; mark period 2 as offline_audit_pass_candidate only in a new analysis version.
